name: assetqr
description: AssetQR — asset registry with QR codes (Next.js + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
